svg.title: The area under a rate graph is the change in the amount
svg.desc: Graph of the rate r(t) at which water flows into a tank, in liters per minute, for t from 0 to 12 minutes. The graph is made of line segments through (0, 2), (4, 6), (6, 6), (8, 0), (10, -3) and (12, -3). The region above the t-axis from 0 to 8 is shaded crimson and has area 34, meaning 34 liters flow in. The region below the axis from 8 to 12 is shaded blue and has area 9, meaning 9 liters drain out. The net change in the water is 34 minus 9, or 25 liters.

text.tspan: Net change from t = 0 to 12: 34 − 9 = 25 liters
